claims: Denver defeated Wisconsin 2-1 to win the 2026 NCAA Men's Hockey Championship.
Wisconsin defeated North Dakota 2-1 in Semifinal 1 of the 2026 NCAA Frozen Four.
Denver defeated Michigan 4-3 in 2OT in Semifinal 2 of the 2026 NCAA Frozen Four.
The 2026 NCAA Frozen Four was in Las Vegas.
The Denver Pioneers secured their title with a comeback in the third period.
Denver overcame a 3-1 deficit to defeat Michigan in 2OT in a 92-minute marathon.
Denver goaltender Johnny Hicks was MOP.
Johnny Hicks stopped 49 shots in the semifinal, as noted in the NCAA.com live update.
Johnny Hicks played a key role in the final, as noted in the NCAA.com live update.
The Denver Pioneers secured the title with a comeback win, as detailed in the USA Today article.
